metadata.name: PAHS Daily Content Engine
metadata.description: Generates a seven-day branded content campaign for the Pottsville Crimson Tide and Lattimore Life & Legacy partnership, including captions, visual directions, calls to action, and final quality control.

nodes.label: Campaign Foundation
Monday Momentum
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Monday content pack.

Daily theme: Monday Momentum
Core message: Start strong. Protect what matters.

Develop content that connects the beginning of the week, preparation, discipline, and protecting family goals. Reference {business_name}, {school_partner}, and {team_name} naturally without overstating the partnership.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Main hook
3. Primary social caption of 90 to 150 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Story or reel text in three frames
6. Visual headline
7. Visual subheadline
8. Detailed square-post visual brief
9. Fifteen-second video concept
10. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
11. Five relevant hashtags
12. Compliance review

Match the voice described in {brand_voice}. Use only assets listed in {approved_assets}. Avoid fear-based selling, guaranteed outcomes, and unsupported claims.

nodes.label: Tuesday Teamwork
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Tuesday content pack.

Daily theme: Tuesday Teamwork
Core message: Build winning momentum.

Focus on teamwork, coaches, parents, students, local businesses, and financial professionals working together to strengthen the community. Connect teamwork on the field with teamwork in family protection and planning.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Main hook
3. Primary social caption of 90 to 150 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Story or reel text in three frames
6. Visual headline
7. Visual subheadline
8. Detailed square-post visual brief
9. Fifteen-second video concept
10. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
11. Five relevant hashtags
12. Compliance review

Use the strategy and visual rules from the previous output. Maintain {brand_voice}. Do not invent player names, testimonials, sponsorship terms, or insurance outcomes.

nodes.label: Wealth Wednesday
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Wednesday content pack.

Daily theme: Wealth Wednesday
Core message: Turn income into lasting protection.

Create educational content about protecting income, preparing for unexpected events, reducing financial vulnerability, and building a responsible legacy. Keep the explanation accessible to {audience} and avoid personalized financial advice.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Educational hook
3. Primary social caption of 100 to 170 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Three simple educational takeaways
6. Story or reel text in three frames
7. Visual headline
8. Visual subheadline
9. Detailed square-post visual brief
10. Fifteen-second educational video concept
11. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
12. Five relevant hashtags
13. Compliance review

Use the campaign foundation and prior brand guidance. Clearly distinguish general education from individual financial or insurance recommendations. Do not promise wealth, returns, approval, savings, or specific policy performance.

nodes.label: Thrive Thursday
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Thursday content pack.

Daily theme: Thrive Thursday
Core message: Plan today. Strengthen tomorrow.

Focus on proactive planning, reviewing current protection, strengthening financial foundations, and taking one manageable next step. Connect athletic preparation with thoughtful family and legacy planning.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Main hook
3. Primary social caption of 90 to 150 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Three-step action checklist
6. Story or reel text in three frames
7. Visual headline
8. Visual subheadline
9. Detailed square-post visual brief
10. Fifteen-second video concept
11. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
12. Five relevant hashtags
13. Compliance review

Base the content on the campaign foundation. Keep the message encouraging rather than urgent or alarming. Follow {compliance_notes} and do not imply that one product is suitable for everyone.

nodes.label: Family Friday
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Friday content pack.

Daily theme: Family Friday
Core message: Protect the people behind your purpose.

Create emotionally resonant but responsible content about parents, children, caregivers, family goals, and the people who depend on us. Connect family support in the stands with protection away from the field.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Main hook
3. Primary social caption of 90 to 150 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Story or reel text in three frames
6. Visual headline
7. Visual subheadline
8. Detailed square-post visual brief
9. Fifteen-second family-centered video concept
10. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
11. Five relevant hashtags
12. Compliance review

Use the established partnership narrative and {brand_voice}. Avoid exploiting grief, illness, injury, or fear. Do not describe coverage, pricing, or benefits that have not been supplied.

nodes.label: Sponsor Saturday
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Saturday content pack.

Daily theme: Sponsor Saturday
Core message: Community strong. Legacy stronger.

Highlight local partnership, school pride, shared values, and responsible community support. Explain why businesses supporting youth, families, and local programs can help strengthen the broader community.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Partnership-focused hook
3. Primary social caption of 90 to 150 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Community appreciation statement
6. Story or reel text in three frames
7. Visual headline
8. Visual subheadline
9. Detailed square-post visual brief
10. Fifteen-second partnership video concept
11. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
12. Five relevant hashtags
13. Compliance review

Use only confirmed details from the campaign inputs and {approved_assets}. Do not imply that players, families, coaches, or the school recommend specific insurance or financial products.

nodes.label: Security Sunday
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation above, create the Sunday content pack.

Daily theme: Security Sunday
Core message: Protect the people who matter most.

Create reflective Sunday content centered on family security, reviewing responsibilities, preparing for the week, and scheduling a no-pressure protection review. Connect the message to community, purpose, and long-term legacy.

Output format:
1. Content objective
2. Reflective hook
3. Primary social caption of 90 to 150 words
4. Short caption of no more than 40 words
5. Sunday reflection question
6. Story or reel text in three frames
7. Visual headline
8. Visual subheadline
9. Detailed square-post visual brief
10. Fifteen-second reflective video concept
11. Call to action using {offer}, {phone}, and {landing_page}
12. Five relevant hashtags
13. Compliance review

Follow the campaign foundation and {brand_voice}. Keep the invitation helpful and low-pressure. Do not use religious claims unless they are explicitly included in the campaign inputs.

nodes.label: Weekly Synthesis
nodes.prompt:
Using the campaign foundation and all seven daily content packs above, assemble one coordinated weekly publishing package for the week beginning {week_start_date}.

Ensure the seven posts form a connected narrative without repeating the same opening, call to action, example, or sentence structure.

Output format:
1. Weekly campaign title
2. Weekly campaign summary
3. Publishing table with day, theme, recommended platform, recommended format, primary hook, and call to action
4. Final Monday content
5. Final Tuesday content
6. Final Wednesday content
7. Final Thursday content
8. Final Friday content
9. Final Saturday content
10. Final Sunday content
11. Seven visual production prompts
12. Seven short-form video scripts
13. Weekly hashtag bank
14. Asset checklist
15. Contact and landing-page block

Standardize all references to {business_name}, {school_partner}, {team_name}, {phone}, and {landing_page}. Preserve the approved daily themes while improving variety, clarity, and campaign flow.

nodes.label: Brand and Compliance QA
nodes.prompt:
Review the complete weekly package above as a final brand editor, social media strategist, and insurance-marketing compliance checker.

Validate the following:
1. Every day has a distinct hook and purpose.
2. The weekly narrative progresses logically.
3. All contact information exactly matches {phone} and {landing_page}.
4. The school and team references remain respectful and accurate.
5. The partnership is not described beyond the information provided.
6. No unsupported statistics, testimonials, guarantees, savings claims, policy claims, or financial outcomes appear.
7. The content follows {compliance_notes}.
8. All visual recommendations use only {approved_assets}.
9. Calls to action consistently support {campaign_goal} and {offer}.
10. Captions are clear, readable, and suitable for {platforms}.

Correct every issue you find. Return only the final approved weekly content package, followed by a brief section titled Final QA Notes that lists any statements requiring human legal, carrier, school, or brand approval before publication.

keys.name: audience
values: PAHS families, alumni, supporters, local businesses, and community members

keys.name: campaign_goal
values: Increase community awareness and generate appointments for family protection and legacy reviews

keys.name: offer
values: Schedule a complimentary protection and legacy review

keys.name: platforms
values: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, and short-form vertical video

keys.name: brand_voice
values: Confident, encouraging, family-centered, educational, community-minded, and professional

keys.name: approved_assets
values: Approved Lattimore Life & Legacy logo, approved Pottsville Crimson Tide partnership graphics, supplied football imagery, approved QR code, navy, gold, crimson, white, and black brand colors

keys.name: compliance_notes
values: Use general educational language, avoid guarantees and unsupported claims, do not provide individualized insurance or financial advice, and require human approval before publication
